scope: Independent read-only review of finalized native sync requests, durable queue recovery, hierarchy merging, profile hydration and error classification; synthetic hosted regression and Swift core evidence. Device/account convergence is separate.

confirmed: Prerequisite bootstrap prepends current hard foreign-key parents before every unchanged legacy queue entry; original IDs, payloads, clocks and FIFO suffix are retained.
Owner/version marker is persisted only after durable prefix publication; marker-write failure retains the prefix and permits safe idempotent retry duplication.
Outbound snapshot signatures cannot suppress prerequisite bootstrap; stale parent adoption or queue failures do not discard pending writes.
Folder and passage table pulls merge atomically under local LWW validation before acknowledging rows/cursors.
account_preferences requests order by owner_id; backend/schema errors remain actionable while typed connectivity failures retain offline classification.
No additional checked-in DTO column or enum mismatch was identified against the complete migration history.
Immediate practice enqueue collects passage provenance once and orders only hard parentPassageID dependencies, accepting valid split/merge-back provenance cycles.
First-login profile preparation downloads required score organization and atomic score/page-edit snapshots before synchronous profile adoption without clearing cloud working-on selections.
Asynchronous profile preparation rejects changed account/generation, cancellation, local profile or pending core/backend/editor intent before any stale profile publication or hydration receipt.
Atomic score/page-edit download preserves display-page bounds and bookmarks while retaining the existing PDF replacement guard for the actual LWW metadata winner.

findings.summary: Combined provenance and parent traversal can reject a valid split-then-merge-back graph during immediate practice enqueue.
findings.required_behavior: Collect provenance closure with cycle tolerance, then order only hard parentPassageID dependencies.
findings.resolution: Closure collection is cycle tolerant; a separate parentPassageID-only topological pass determines upsert order.

findings.summary: First-login cloud profile hydration can reference scores before those scores are pulled, failing validation before sync reaches the library.
findings.required_behavior: Retain cloud working-on selections and hydrate their references after required library data is available.
findings.resolution: Optional asynchronous dependency preparation precedes existing synchronous complete-profile adoption.

findings.summary: The first asynchronous hydration draft could overwrite edits staged while downloading score references.
findings.resolution: Two-phase preparation snapshots the current profile and pending core/backend/editor ownership maps; any change throws before synchronous publication or receipt. Suspended-adopter same-account edit/reinstantiate and account-switch tests pass.

findings.summary: Valid display pages and bookmarks after inserted blank/staff pages could fail fresh download when piece metadata arrived before page edits.
findings.resolution: pullScoreSnapshot fetches pieces and page_edits before one atomic LWW store transaction and acknowledges both only after successful commit. Later bookmarks see the complete reading order.

findings.summary: The initial atomic score merge bypassed existing protection against replacing PDF bytes underneath offline annotations/history.
findings.resolution: The selected LWW metadata winner must pass requireReplaceableScore when pdfFileName or pageCount changes, before atomic assignment.
